# Copilot repository instructions

- Preserve existing functionality, build tooling, and licensing. Inspect the repository before changing code.
- Never commit secrets, seed phrases, signing keys, API credentials, `.env` files, or CDP credential JSON.
- Do not initiate wallet transfers, token mints, blockchain deployments, production releases, or destructive operations without explicit approval.
- Prefer minimal reviewed pull requests with tests, linting, dependency audits, and rollback notes.
- Treat AI pet, Æther Vault, and Lorem Ipsom Protocol integrations as optional modules; never assume their services or credentials are available.
- Use least-privilege permissions and keep production keys outside source control.
